summary: All 4 phases done. Himalaya is held at v1.2.0 by a frozen nixpkgs-himalaya flake input plus overlays/himalaya-pin.nix (out path identical to the pre-change one), and modules/home/email/msmtp.nix generates ~/.config/msmtp/config with gmail and logos accounts selected by envelope-from. nix flake check, the standalone home build and the hamsa system build all pass; the user-level generation is activated. verify-touched.sh exited 1 on agent-system suites under .claude/scripts with a touched set of two specs paths only; the full gate is deferred to the batch stage. Live sender checks and sudo nixos-rebuild switch remain user steps.

completion_data.completion_summary: Pinned the Himalaya CLI at v1.2.0 via a dedicated flake input and overlay, and added a declarative Home Manager module generating ~/.config/msmtp/config with gmail and logos accounts selected by envelope-from. Flake check and both builds pass; user-level generation activated.

sapience_notes.subject: dotfiles Himalaya CLI pin
sapience_notes.value: Himalaya is held at v1.2.0 by a dedicated flake input nixpkgs-himalaya naming nixpkgs revision 567a49d1913ce81ac6e9582e3553dd90a955875f, exposed through overlays/himalaya-pin.nix. Chosen over a src/cargoHash override because it freezes the Rust toolchain with the source; the feature-overridden package evaluated to the same store path as the previously installed one, so nothing was rebuilt.

sapience_notes.subject: Home Manager programs.msmtp configContent rendering
sapience_notes.value: With only configContent set and no accounts.email tree, home-manager release-26.05 renders ~/.config/msmtp/config as a single '# Generated by Home Manager.' comment line followed by the configContent text verbatim, and installs the package itself, so a separate home.packages entry is redundant.

sapience_notes.subject: Proton Bridge SMTP for a sendmail-style client
sapience_notes.value: The logos account must use the literal host 127.0.0.1 on port 1025 with STARTTLS, because the Bridge certificate is self-signed with an IP-only subject alternative name; verification passes only on a host whose system bundle trusts the Bridge CA (hamsa does).

sapience_notes.subject: Claude Code harness foreground Bash limit
sapience_notes.value: A foreground Bash call running past roughly 180 seconds was moved to the background by the harness even with a 600000 ms timeout parameter; a nix flake check that rebuilds lint derivations crosses that line. Launching detached and polling a log in calls under 175 seconds avoided it.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-touched.sh touched-path derivation in the dotfiles repo
sapience_notes.value: Run with no path arguments after three phase commits, it derived only the two uncommitted specs paths as touched and none of the committed nix or doc files, then ran a 19-suite selected pass plus an 86-suite free-class OWED fallback; six agent-system suites under .claude/scripts failed with causes not established.

next_steps: User: run the per-account sender checks listed in the summary, then sudo nixos-rebuild switch --flake .#hamsa. Batch stage: full gate set; investigate the agent-system suite failures separately.
